'''2015 Worlds Day 2 Steve Harpster DS This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Steve Harpster]] at [[2015 World Championship]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Steve Harpster]]
* '''Event:''' [[2015 World Championship]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time / Pray I Don't Alter It Any Further|ECC-D-thisdealisgettingworseallthetime.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open Deal Harpster DS 2015 Worlds.txt |Download]]
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2015-world-championships/ PC list]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261013125658/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2015-world-championships.html Internet Archive]
